args.text: First look: red popcorn machine in the middle with a big ring around it - orange arc on the upper left, a yellow arc on the lower left, grey rest. There's a white pointing-hand icon on the machine, so I think I should tap/press the machine. Coins at top = 0. Bottom card: a grey bucket, 30 coins, up arrow - probably an upgrade I can't afford yet (greyed). Top: back, sound, restart. My guess: tap or hold the machine to pop corn, maybe timing with the ring (stop in the yellow zone?).

Tapped the machine: got 1 coin. A little grey marker flashed at 12 o'clock on the ring, then vanished. Not sure if that's where a needle stopped. Next I'll try holding the machine to see if something fills or a needle moves around the ring toward the yellow zone.

Holding = a needle sweeps counterclockwise from 12 o'clock through orange. 2s hold stopped it in orange (~10:30) and gave +3 with some brownish kernels. 3.5s hold gave a big black smoke cloud and only +1 - I burned it! So the yellow zone (9 to 7 o'clock) is probably the sweet spot and I overshot. Trying ~2.7s.

2.7s also burned (+1). 2.3s gave +3, no smoke. The bucket icon in the bottom card is filling with gold and a yellow band is rising in the card - looks like progress toward the 30-coin upgrade. The window between good and burnt seems tight; hunting for the yellow zone between 2.3 and 2.7s. Trying 2.5.

2.5s burned too. New theory: the needle actually goes CLOCKWISE all the way round: grey (raw) -> yellow (perfect?) -> orange (overdone) -> back at 12 = burnt. My 2.0 and 2.3s holds were in the orange part just before 12, that's why the needle sat near 12 / 10:30. So yellow should be around 1.5s. Trying 1.55s.

YES! 1.55s hold landed the needle in the yellow zone: +10 and golden popcorn bursting out. That felt great after all the burning. 20 coins now, the card at the bottom is almost full of yellow. Doing it again to reach 30 for the upgrade.

Bought the upgrade for 30: machine got bigger with a red-white striped awning and bunting - nice visual reward. Next upgrade is a cart on wheels for 54. Ring also changed: a new pale white segment right after 12 o'clock, yellow zone looks a bit bigger. Not sure what the white bit is - maybe a quick bonus zone. Holding 1.55s again to see if timing is the same.

After the upgrade a perfect pop pays +16 instead of +10 - so the upgrade multiplies the payout, which feels good. Same 1.55s timing works. Grinding toward 54 for the cart. I'm curious about the white bit after 12 o'clock but don't want to waste a pop.
Bought the cart (54): machine is now a big popcorn cart on wheels, next goal 97. Yellow zone grew again. Fun little loop: hit the yellow, buy the next machine.
